name: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, Pregnant women, lactating mothers, and children in the age group of 0 to 3 years receive Take Home Ration (THR) in the form of ready-to-eat nutritious ladoos on a monthly basis. Additionally, children aged 3 to 6 years are provided with hot cooked meals at the Anganwadi Centres.

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a child below 6 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a Pregnant Woman. 1. The applicant should be a Lactating Mother. 1. The applicant should be an Adolescent Girl aged 14-18 years.
